verdict.rationale: An interactive API reference is a fair question for a SaaS platform with an API, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of an interactive API explorer or runnable examples. The API access tokens doc covers only token scoping, and probes for OpenAPI/Swagger specs at common paths all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
